claims.text: The source defines WaveNet: dilated-causal autoregressive CNN on raw waveform (softmax mu-law 256-way, gated units, residual+skip, global/local conditioning); receptive-field scaling via dilation stacks 1,2,4..512 plus context stacks; sequential sample-by-sample inference.

Reported numbers: TTS MOS WaveNet with linguistic+logF0 features 4.21±0.081 (EN) / 4.08±0.085 (ZH) vs LSTM 3.67/3.79 vs concatenative 3.86/3.47 vs natural 4.55/4.21; gap cut 51% EN, 69% ZH; 44h/109-speaker VCTK; TIMIT raw-audio PER 18.8.

limitations.text: Receptive field ~240-300 ms misses long F0/prosody; sequential sampling costly; music lacks long-range coherence.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Parallel-inference latency and multi-speaker zero-shot similarity scores not established.
